description: This file defines the ProrationEmailService class responsible for sending invoice and reminder emails related to billing proration, including methods for email dispatch and invoice URL retrieval.

classes.name: ProrationEmailService
classes.description: Service class for sending billing proration related emails, including invoice and reminder emails, with internal methods for invoice URL retrieval.

methods.name: sendInvoiceEmail
methods.description: Sends an invoice email for a specific proration, including permission checks and email dispatch.

methods.name: sendReminderEmail
methods.description: Sends reminder emails for a specific proration, skipping if already charged, with permission checks.

methods.name: getInvoiceUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the hosted invoice URL from Stripe given an invoice ID, with error handling.
